topic: how four words written for De Beers helped make the diamond engagement ring the expectation
storyAngle: A slogan helped turn a common option into an expected one.
doNotClaim: Do NOT say De Beers invented the engagement ring (rings with and without diamonds were already in use before the campaign).
Do not give any percentage of pre-war diamond rings; no reliable figure was found.
Do not give any price. The exact first-ad date varies (1947 coined, possibly 1948 first ad), so say she wrote it in 1947.

facts.claim: In 1947 copywriter Frances Gerety of the N. W. Ayer agency wrote the four words "A Diamond Is Forever" for De Beers.
facts.note: multiple sources agree on 1947 for the writing

facts.claim: Diamond engagement rings existed before the campaign but were far from universal.
The slogan has appeared in De Beers engagement advertising ever since.
By 1951 the ad agency reported that jewelers were saying a girl is not engaged unless she has a diamond engagement ring.
